Last year, after a some resistance, we agreed to do a secret santa and it went pretty well. Or so I thought. This year 1 sibling threw a fit about doing it. Last year was the 1st time everyone brought something. Another sibling, who is hosting Christmas, sided with her and said that we won't do a secret Santa but that you don't have to bring gifts if you don't want to.
